contract.document_name.rationale: The contract is titled "AGENCY AGREEMENT", and the heading of Exhibit A repeats the name.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The contract was "Signed and effective this 25th day of May, 1999"; the other dates belong to the project memorandum, the commission schedule or the Y2K clause.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The contract was "Signed and effective this 25th day of May, 1999".

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement has no fixed term or expiry date and runs until terminated on notice.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section I.5 says the agreement is interpreted under the laws of the State of Nevada; the other Nevada mentions are territory, the party name or the arbitration clause.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section F.2 says termination is subject to any automatic renewal or extension for one year as required by law.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Section F.2 says the agreement ends when either party gives at least 120 days' advance written notice, subject to the one-year statutory renewal.
